common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Changing the compass radius between drawing the first and second intersecting arcs when constructing 60° angle.
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: The compass radius MUST remain strictly unchanged between step 1 (base arc) and step 2 (intersecting arc) to form an equilateral triangle.

common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Setting compass radius less than half the length of line segment when attempting perpendicular bisector.
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: Always set compass radius strictly GREATER than half the line segment length (> 0.5 XY), otherwise the arcs will not intersect.
